subject: Evaluation asset gateways & usage frames
messages:
From: Brittany Alvarez <brittany@brightwave.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation asset exchange & proposed MAP for pilot

Hi Priyom / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our ML and product teams are keen to run a short pilot. To move forward we need to exchange a small set of evaluation assets (prompt packs + ~2k testcases + a redacted sample corpus) under a mutual action plan so we can validate model behavior against our acceptance criteria.

High‑level asks from BrightWave:
- A MAP that lists milestone dates, acceptance tests (precision / recall thresholds on the QA set), and a takeback/deletion window after the pilot.
- A narrow, limited‑use license: assets are for evaluation only, no derivative training or redistribution.
- A canary ingest for 50–100 prompts to validate handling and anonymization before full ingest.

Can you share a short MAP draft and the ingest checklist? We are handling contracting on our side and I can loop procurement once we have the milestones.

Attaching a CSV of the sample IDs we plan to send (we'll redact PII before transfer). Happy to sync today if useful.

Thanks,
Brittany Alvarez
Head of ML Partnerships | BrightWave AI
---
attachments: sample-list.csv (text/csv)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Brittany Alvarez <brittany@brightwave.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluation asset exchange & proposed MAP for pilot

Hi Brittany — thanks, this is exactly the kind of scope we can support. I've attached a concise MAP draft (MAP-draft-v3.pdf) and a short ingest guideline (ingest-guidelines.md) that covers redaction expectations, sample formats, and our canary procedure.

Proposed MAP highlights (high‑level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): sign MAP + DocuSign; BrightWave shares redacted sample-list.csv
- Week 1: canary ingest (50–100 prompts) + verification run (karthik leads)
- Week 2–3: full prompt pack + testcase ingest (ephemeral sandbox)
- Week 4: acceptance run and metrics review (pass/fail criteria in MAP)
- Week 5: takedown window begins (30 days after close, assets destroyed unless otherwise agreed)

Key constraints we put in the draft: evaluation only; no use for model training or redistribution; sandbox tokens rotated after each ingest; access logs retained for 90 days and shared on request.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the acceptance thresholds in the attached MAP (I put placeholders for the QA thresholds).
2) We'll run the canary the following Monday (May 3) if that works for you.
3) If canary passes, we proceed to full ingest the week after.

I've copied Kar (karthik) to confirm the canary technical checklist and Vanessa to coordinate procurement/contracting cadence.

Best,
Priyom Das
Strategy & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

attachments: MAP-draft-v3.pdf, ingest-guidelines.md
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation asset exchange & proposed MAP for pilot

Quick technical notes re: canary + full ingest:
- Canary: we'll run it on a reserved sandbox cluster with strict rate limits (50–100 prompts, 1–2 concurrent). We'll validate tokenization/encoding parity and a KV cache stress sample.
- Please ensure PII is redacted; we will still run our automatic redaction checks and flag items.
- For the full ingest, limit file size to 250MB per archive; if you need higher throughput we can arrange burst lanes but that requires a short SOC and SSO onboarding step.
- We'll produce an ingest report (artifacts: ingest_report.json + brief summary).

If the canary shows any anomalies we'll snapshot logs and do a one‑hour joint triage. Otherwise, full ingest moves ahead.

-kar
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Priyom / Kar — that timeline works. A couple quick clarifications from procurement:

We are ready to run the canary on May 5th (US/PST). Procurement will review the MAP once you add the training restriction. I'll also send the redacted sample-list.csv by end of day tomorrow.

Brittany
